activation_diagnosis.scope: Read-only pure-Python activation arithmetic on saved initial/final models and the 168 selected training geometries. No native executable, GPU, Docker, training, parameter change or validation-driven tuning. This file records an already completed analysis.

method.partition: Only IDs in split.json train_ids; original dataset ordering retained.
method.geometry: Nonperiodic only. For each central atom, enumerate other atoms with r<6 by neighbor species, sort by (r,row), and pad each species list to sel=[4,4,4]. Actual radius range excludes padding.
method.radial_switch: q=1 for r<1; otherwise t=(r-1)/(6-1), z=1-t, q=z^3*(1+3*t+6*t^2). s=q/r; raw R=[s,s*dx/r,s*dy/r,s*dz/r]. Padding raw R is zero.
method.normalization: R[a]=(raw_R[a]-mean[a])/std[a]; saved models both use fixed mean0,std1.
method.descriptor: For each row G=pair_embedding(R[0]); B[m,a]+=G[m]*R[a]/12; D[m,k]=sum_a B[m,a]*B[k,a] for m=0..3 and k=0..1, flattened m then k.
method.network: z[j]=bias[j]+sum_i input[i]*weights[i][j]; tanh hidden/embedding, linear final. Reject any residual other than none or non-null timestep. Pool preactivation z across all training atoms and species, separately by embedding/fitting layer index.
method.statistics: Sort abs(values). p50 uses index floor((n-1)/2), p95 uses index floor(0.95*(n-1)); no interpolation. Saturation fractions use strict abs(tanh(z))>threshold. Minimum derivative is min(1-tanh(z)^2). Padded embedding activations are included.
method.interpretation: No broad tanh saturation detected. Small descriptor/fitting inputs imply mostly near-linear fitting responses, not saturation. This arithmetic diagnostic is not an independent native EFV correctness test.
method.loss_formula: Energy component=(energy_per_atom_RMSE/0.1)^2. Force component=frame_weighted_force_RMSE^2 because sF=1 and wE=wF=1. Use frame-weighted force RMSE, not pooled component RMSE, to match the trainer's arithmetic mean across frames.

cpu_two_update_feasibility.estimate_basis: Upper-bound primitive operation counts: dmul<=4,dadd<=2,dscale<=4,dtanh<=6,dual_constant<=2; 531 leaves once per fresh frame Tape; empty/zero fast paths can reduce this.
cpu_two_update_feasibility.request: Fresh same initial model/dataset and exact split/minibatch/loss/Adam/schedule. Both steps=2,new output directories. CPU device=cpu and remove config cuda_gradient,cuda_loss,cuda_tiling,fixed_geometry_cache. Preserve checkpoint_every=100; final step2 checkpoint is forced. CPU schema v6,GPU schema v8 expected.
cpu_two_update_feasibility.comparison: Check finite lengths531, step2, exact hashes/partitions/sampler/frozen fields; all neural parameters and both moments: abs(delta)<=2e-10*(1+max(abs(CPU),abs(GPU))). Report actual maximum errors separately. This is a recommended diagnostic gate, not a measured result.

timing.excluded: Container lifecycle, source compilation, static analysis, documentation. Single observations including startup/JIT/cache, sync, transfers and I/O; not throughput/speedup measurements.

conclusion: Evidence supports loss weighting within this narrow model/training setup as the observed regression cause. No inspected mapping/baseline or two-update CPU/CUDA optimizer defect was found; no code fix is justified. This does not exclude shared implementations defects, prove all1000updates agree, or establish architecture capacity/physical readiness.
remaining_limitations: E/atom and force RMSE remain large.
Total-energy training RMSE worsens slightly under controlled run even though E/atom improves slightly.
Training C3H3O4 E/atom worsens; every group is retained.
Validation is only index-held-out within three composition groups; no trajectory-independent or final-test claim.
Normalization and architecture were deliberately unchanged, so their independent effect is unmeasured.
